text:
Alisa: Quick heads-up — here's the weekly release-train briefing. We're doing a controlled ramp this week with a canary handback window on Wednesday. Please ack if you have rollout blockers.
Devon: ack — can you clarify the handback window timezone?
Alisa: Handback: Wed 03:00–06:00 UTC. During that window no new model major-version canaries; minor patches allowed under 10% traffic.
Maria: Noted. Any SLA adjustments? Our latency SLO on embeddings is tight after the quant change.
Alisa: SLA stays the same. Ops will throttle background batch jobs if we hit queue depth > 250.
PJ: I'll put a temporary traffic cap in the routing policy: max_canary_percent=30 for the window.
release-bot: [deploy-plan] Canary ramp scheduled: 2024-11-13T02:50Z -> increase to 30% over 20m, hold 60m, then handback.
Raj: Is there an exception process if a customer-facing regression is flagged during handback?
Alisa: Yes — open an exception in #release-exceptions and ping me + @oncall-sre within 5 minutes. We have a 2-minute rollback threshold if error-rate > 1.5x baseline.
oncall-sre: Confirmed. Oncall will coordinate fallback to the previous quantized build (v2.3.q) if anomalies persist.
Devon: Any sequencing changes for regional cutovers? APAC windows usually prefer midnight local.
Alisa: Good point — APAC regional cutovers will be scheduled outside the UTC handback: Thu 00:30–03:00 JST. Ops will mirror routing caps.
Maria: Will we run the A/B evals post-handback? I can schedule quick evals for the prompt suite.
Alisa: Yes, run the core evals within 4 hours post-handback. If quality delta > 1.2x degradation on any metric, escalate.
PJ: Putting the checklist in the release train doc now: https://go/redwood/release-train/checklist :thumbsup:
Devon: LGTM. I'll be available for rollback if needed.
Alisa: Thanks — quick timeline recap:
- Tue 02:00 UTC: infra maintenance window starts (no heavy backfills)
- Wed 03:00–06:00 UTC: Canary handback window (max 30% canary)
- Thu 00:30–03:00 JST: APAC cutovers
If you need an exemption, file in #release-exceptions before 12:00 UTC Tue.
Maria: Filing one for a late eval run — pinged #release-exceptions.
release-bot: Rolling note — deploy-plan edited by Alisa at 3501234575
Alisa: Thanks team. Short standup tomorrow 09:15 PT to confirm readiness. :coffee:
